description:
You are a landscape architect commissioned to design the exterior grounds for the Contemporary House. The property currently has minimal landscaping and the client wants a complete outdoor design package.

Client requirements:
1. Plantings: Add at least four trees or large shrubs distributed around the property (not all in the same corner)
2. Circulation: Add a driveway or primary walkway/path leading to the main entrance of the house
3. Outdoor living: Add an outdoor living structure attached to or adjacent to the house — a deck, patio, terrace, or pergola
4. Exterior finish: Update the exterior wall material or paint color of the house itself to complement the new landscape design

When the landscape design is complete, export:
1. Overhead/top-down site plan view → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\landscape_site_plan.jpg
2. 3D perspective view of the exterior → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\landscape_3d_view.jpg
3. Save the project to → C:\Users\Docker\Documents\landscape_design.dpn

Note: DreamPlan is already running with the Contemporary House project loaded. Use the terrain, landscaping, and exterior design tools to complete all four client requirements before exporting.
